nuggets.text: The Huskies are in their first Mountain West season, joining as a football-only member after decades in the MAC.
Rob Harley, an Elmhurst, Illinois, native, won a national title as an Ohio State safety on the 2002 Buckeyes.
Rob Harley's 2025 Huskies defense ranked 12th in FBS in passing yards allowed, at 173.9 per game.
The Huskies beat No. 5 Notre Dame 16-14 in 2024, the first top-5 win ever by a Mid-American Conference team.
Huskies legend Jordan Lynch was inducted into the College Football Hall of Fame in January 2026.
Jordan Lynch set an FBS record for a quarterback with 321 rushing yards in one game at Huskie Stadium in 2013.
Huskie Stadium hosted Illinois' first major college game on artificial turf, a 47-30 Huskies win over Idaho in 1969.
Northern Illinois played its first football game in 1899, against DeKalb High School.
The Huskies have forced a turnover in each of their last four games, including an end-zone interception at Iowa.
The Huskies and Redbirds first met in 1906, a 6-5 Northern Illinois win, and last played in 2019.
